description: Verbatim live response from the UF Schedule of Courses API, truncated to the first two courses of the page. COURSES was 14 items; LASTCONTROLNUMBER, RETRIEVEDROWS and TOTALROWS are left at their real values so the paging counters read correctly against the truncation.

COURSES.name: Information and Database Systems 1
COURSES.description: First part of a two-course sequence that studies the essential concepts, principles and techniques of modern database systems. Topics include modeling and querying of data using conceptual data models as well as the development of a database application.

sections.note:
Through March 27, 2026, only fifth‑year seniors majoring in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Digital Arts & Sciences, or Data Science.
March 28 through April 3, 2026, any senior in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Digital Arts & Sciences or Data Science.
April 4 through April 17, 2026, any junior or senior in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Digital Arts & Sciences, or Data Science may enroll.
After April 17, 2026, any computing major may register.
After, August 3 open to all UF majors.

COURSES.name: Computer and Information Security
COURSES.description: Covers systematic threat and risk assessment; programmed threats and controls in hardware, software, and human procedures; security policies, models, and mechanisms; theoretical limitations and practical implementations; certification and accreditation standards; and case study reviews. Includes projects.
